## Why visit

A satisfying local-brewery destination in an industrial building with a strong sense of place. The first-floor tap sits above the brewery, and the range centres on its own traditional-style beers. It is particularly well suited to a Ramsbottom outing or a carefully timed East Lancashire Railway day with Bury’s Trackside. In November, plan the return independently of any assumption that heritage trains run like a normal frequent service. The brewery connection and opportunity to compare its beers justify the journey; a tour is a separate arrangement and should not be assumed.

## Beer

Official site confirms onsite ales; CAMRA describes a broad range of Irwell Works cask beers, mainly using English hops/barley.

## Plan the visit

First-floor bar via stairs. Confirm any tour separately; the taproom is the normal visitor experience.

**Getting there:** Ramsbottom town centre; use bus links or the East Lancashire Railway only on confirmed operating days.
